policies.name: Comentários de posts visíveis são visíveis
Comunidades públicas são visíveis a todos
Membros autenticados pode ver comunidades privadas que pertence
Public cannot read admin audit log
Public reads safe approved archive assets
policies.using:
((bucket_scope = 'public_safe'::text) AND (review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (public_url IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_archive_items i
  WHERE ((i.id = comun_archive_assets.archive_item_id) AND (i.status = 'published'::text) AND (i.visibility = 'public'::text)))))

policies.name: Public reads published collection links
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_archive_collections c
  WHERE ((c.id = comun_archive_collection_items.collection_id) AND (c.status = 'published'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_archive_items i
  WHERE ((i.id = comun_archive_collection_items.archive_item_id) AND (i.status = 'published'::text) AND (i.visibility = 'public'::text)))))

policies.name: Public reads public archive relations
policies.using:
((internal_note IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_archive_items i
  WHERE ((i.id = comun_archive_relations.source_item_id) AND (i.status = 'published'::text) AND (i.visibility = 'public'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_archive_items i
  WHERE ((i.id = comun_archive_relations.target_item_id) AND (i.status = 'published'::text) AND (i.visibility = 'public'::text)))))

policies.name: Members read only their own community links
Members read only their own active community roles
policies.using:
((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_community_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = comun_community_role_assignments.membership_id) AND (m.member_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (m.state = 'member'::text)))))

policies.name: Public reads tasks linked to visible work groups
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_community_work_groups g
  WHERE ((g.id = comun_community_work_group_tasks.group_id) AND (g.state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text])))))

policies.name: Public reads active community work groups
Public can read public safe approved pauta evidence
policies.using:
((status = 'approved'::text) AND (sensitivity = 'public_safe'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_pauta_spaces spaces
  WHERE ((spaces.id = comun_pauta_evidence_items.pauta_id) AND (spaces.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (spaces.status <> 'archived'::text)))))

policies.name: Public can read public pauta spaces
Public can read public pauta tasks
policies.using:
((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM comun_pauta_spaces spaces
  WHERE ((spaces.id = comun_pauta_tasks.pauta_id) AND (spaces.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (spaces.status <> 'archived'::text)))))

policies.name: Visitors can insert reports
policies.check: ((raw_text IS NOT NULL) AND (status = 'received'::text) AND (public_text IS NULL) AND (internal_notes IS NULL))

policies.name: Qualquer autenticado pode editar página publicada
Posts de comunidades públicas são visíveis
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM communities c
  WHERE ((c.id = posts.community_id) AND (c.is_public = true)))) AND (is_removed = false))
